description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for database operations related to purging employee data. It includes methods to check if an employee can be purged and to extract data based on employee numbers.

classes.name: PurgeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for handling purge-related database operations for employee data.

methods.name: isEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Checks if an employee identified by empNumber is eligible to be purged based on termination record and purge timestamp.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves data from the specified table where the employee number matches, with optional join.
